rss_assessment.explanation: The whole allocation file was measured alone with GC_TIGHT=1 and fixed seed 1 on both exact builds. Evaluator command and largest-child high-water marks rise 0.068%; VM command and largest-child marks rise 0.088%. These positive deltas remain explicit rather than being rounded to a memory reduction. Sampled simultaneous family RSS falls on both engines (evaluator 520,992 to 399,360 KiB; VM 496,528 to 421,168 KiB). Family samples measure concurrent wrapper/runner/forked-child pages separately from kernel per-process high-water marks. All 76 cases complete and match the corresponding ordinary-GC case results. The sub-0.1% per-process changes and lower family peaks show no material memory regression in this controlled local pair; this is local assessment, not external review or platform acceptance.

pmu_assessment.explanation: The requested instruction rows are measured on the actual post-PR251 main40b25633 and integrated runtimef21fc4ce. Ordinary method/block/matrix totals range from -0.618% to +0.044%; all positive rows remain explicit. Method/Proc/lambda keyword-rest controls improve 1.516% to 2.165% on both engines. The owned-packet operation stays inside the existing keyword-rest binding path; ordinary calls receive no new count-only operation or dummy Ruby object. The prerequisite pending-source comparison is already present in this main baseline. These data support final correctness/resource validation and make no claim of external approval or universal zero overhead.
